description: R-SQL-1 SQL-B, SQL-REL: Does one exact SQL text (SELECT L.name, Count(R.rid) AS n, Sum(R.qty) AS s FROM L LEFT JOIN R ON L.id = R.lid GROUP BY L.name ORDER BY L.name;) give the same metadata and rows through Database.OpenRecordset, a temporary QueryDef, and a permanent QueryDef QRoute? For QRoute the stored SQL property is read after CreateQueryDef and again through QueryDefs("QRoute") after QueryDefs.Refresh, and QueryDef.Fields (Name/Type/Size) is read before opening. Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-1-accdb-main opened read-write through ACE DAO; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, Fields Name/Type/Size/SourceTable/SourceField are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
